Requiring a submission every other week is ludicrous and absurd. At times there was no time for the individualdevelopment of the project which is one, if not the only benefit of the fourth year studio, being autonomous, thankfully, Wren handled it well.
This is the first time I actually write my opinion in the evaluation form, for years there has been barely any change in the department or any of its facilities, the curriculum structure has been positively somewhat changed.
Yet, the core of the studio education remains largely  impotent. Lacking in critical thinking, ignorant of world wide trends and deisgn movements and opposed to personal development of an individual, as a person and a designer.
I truly believe there has to be a paradigm shift in the idealogy of this department, a lot of talent, interest and potential is thrown away for the sake of having a large archived data base of submissions.
The aforementioned applies to most of the studio sections I have been through and does not in any way solely represent my experience for this semester.

instructor: Stüdyo dersinin mimarlık bölümünün en önemli dersi olduğunu düşünüyorum ve maalesef ki bu hocamızın bu dersi vermek için her konuda yetersiz olduğunu düşünüyorum. Bütün dönem boyunca neredeyse hiçbir kritik alamadan projeye kendimiz geliştirdik. Kritikler için tabikide stüdyoya gittik ama hocayla konuştuğumuz aldığımız tek cevap güzel güzel devam edin oluyordu. Ya da aldığımız kritik ise genellikle şu şekilde oluyordu: “Ağaç türlerine karar verin.” Bu dersin bizim için öneminin farkında olarak bu hocamızın bu dönem stüdyoda bana hiçbir şey kattığını düşünmüyorum. Günün sonunda final jürisine baktığımızda evet stüdyo olarak ortaya çıkan projelerin güzel olduğuna inanıyorum fakat bu tamamen bizim önceki stüdyolardan gelen bilgimiz ve çok çalışmamızla alakalıdır.  Bir jürimizde pazartesi günü jüri olucağı halde pazartesi 1.30 da ki jürimizden yaklaşık yarım saat önce hocamız jüriyi o gün yapmayacağını ve çarşamba sunabiliceğimizi söyleyip bir submission bile almadan öylece bıraktı. Bize bu derste jüri ve kritik konularının ne kadar önemli olduğu öğretildi fakat maalesef bu dönem bu şekilde olmadı. Online derslere geçtiğimizde bize önce grup devam edebileceğimizi söyledi ve ona göre çalışmaya başladık daha sonrasında bir anda grup olamayacağımızı söyledi ve sonrasında yine karar değişikliğine gidip grup devam ettik. Açıkcası derste ne zaman ne olucağı değil.

He is a great teacher. But you have to have a design idea that you can proceed. So, he can help you with the process. Some people needed assistance with their design but they could not get what they needed I guess. As I said, you have to come with an idea to get critics. If you are unable to create your own design ideas and concept on your own without help he is not good for you. But in every other case, he was perfect. Also, I like to create my own design rather than always getting interrupted and teacher design ideas. So that, he was GREAT for me.

Wren is a really sweet and fun person and he really supported us through this unfortunate process of quarantine and tried to help us all he could, which is why he's a great instructor in many ways, including the fact that he's very flexible on having us create unique designs that fit our own design ideas and understanding, rather than forcing his ideas on us. However, some of the weak points are that we sometimes can't quite be sure of what he means when giving critiques, and it would be even better to hear some supporting ideas from him every once in a while, because as much as it's good to make the main design decisions ourselves, it's better to have someone guide us through it as well, to let us know what's working good, what's not working good and what needs to be improved and on which direction. It was good that he asked us what our future steps were, because it's important as a student and a designer to know what you need to work on and how to improve yourself and your design, but more critical and constructive criticism is required in my opinion. Overall, he's one of the best, though he may  need to be more specific in some parts.

Kibar olduğunu düşündüğüm bir hocaydı ama online eğitim döneminde sınıfta ayrıştırıcı bir tavır sergiledi. Bütün öğrencilerin önünde 2-3 hafta boyunca bir öğretmene yakışmayan acemice tavırlar sergileyip, sözlü hakaretler etti. Asla tembel bir öğrenci olmadım  ama buna rağmen emeğime eleştiriden öte aşağılayıcı hakaretler etti. Mimarlığı sadece RENDER almaktan ibaret gören plan ve kesit hakkında kritik alamadığınız, saatlerce vakit ayırıp çizdiğiniz sketchlerinize-eskizlerinize, el çizimlerinize hakaret eden bir öğretmen. Stüdyoda disiplin ve profesyonellikten uzak kişisel ilişkiler üzerinden giden bir dönem geçirdim.

Wren is a great teacher from many aspects. At first his instruction technique seems a bit different from conventional teachers, which encourages the students to draw their own path on their projects. He frequently asks what are you planning to do next on the upcoming phases. At early times I was like why is he keep asking instead of just telling me what to do for next critique. However in time I find out that his way of giving critiques was the only reason that I have end up with a totally unique, inspiring and impressive project. Unlike many other teachers he didn't push us to design according to his design criteria. He always kept encouraging us and our ideas within the boundaries of functioning, responsive and aesthetic architecture. Eventually all the final projects were rich of architectural versatility and aesthetics. Moreover Wren is highly proficient in creating photo realistic renders so everyone have a lot of things to learn from him at rendering. I would like to thank him a lot for always being supportive, understanding and encouraging even more at these exhausting corona virus days.
